author: jacksepticeye
text:
HITMAN put me in their game
I am the new target in Hitman! A 100% accurate version of myself that you’re going to just love. Play it for yourselves:
https://bit.ly/Jacksepticeye_TheHost

They will also be donating to Thankmas! For every successful Silent Assassin completion, IOI is donating $1 up to $25,000 dollars. If anyone would like to support the charity, they can go to the link to donate.
https://bit.ly/TheHost_Thanksmas

So glad ioi asked me to be in the game. It’s been so much fun working with them and they’re so generous too. Dream come true
